title: Waste of money
text: Waste of money. I bought these to go in my vases etc. and I loved the brightness of the lights and the convenience of the remote but the battery life is worthless. They died the first night I used them so I used another one and I turned them off after about an hour with the remote and went to turn them on two days later and they were dead even when they weren’t being used. Don’t waste your money!!
